name: differential_expression
description: Compare expression between mutation-positive and mutation-tested negative cases for a gene.

gene.description: Mutation gene symbol, such as KRAS

limit.description: Number of leading expression genes, from 1 to 20

cohortFilterJson.description: Selected website cohort, supplied by the agent

name: update_cohort
description: Add, replace or remove filters on the researcher's selected cohort, such as "only Black patients" or "drop the sex filter". Give each field and value as the researcher said it; the tool matches them to the data and says if one is ambiguous or unknown. All changes in one call apply together or not at all.

changes.description: The changes to make, applied together.

field.description: The field as the researcher said it, such as race, sex or ISS stage.

op.description: set replaces any value on the field; remove clears it.

values.description: The values as the researcher said them. Leave empty for remove.

cohortFilterJson.description: Selected website cohort, supplied by the agent

name: show_lollipop
description: Show a Lollipop plot in ProteinPaint: where one gene's mutations fall along the protein and how often each occurs in the selected cohort. Use it for requests such as "Show a lollipop plot for KRAS" or "Where do KRAS mutations fall on the protein?". Give the gene as the researcher said it; aliases such as c-Myc resolve to MYC.

gene.description: The gene as the researcher said it, such as KRAS or c-Myc.

cohortFilterJson.description: Selected website cohort, supplied by the agent
